title: ID0412516-DC/Si-D/FI-[FLEET] - Version 6.1.3 CCV LED always turns on when more than 1 authentication method
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
When CPO is using more than RFID for authentication, CCV LED will always turns on. I have tested this with version 6.1.2 and now with version 6.1.3. IF only RFID is enabled, CCV LED doesnt turn on.
Solution:
Update to v9.0.X
Update: 14/Mar/2025 - R&D ticket created EVC3-8951
update: 21/Mar/2025 - R&D is proposing for the V9.0.X
